review_conclusions: The input uses the normal non-LTO O3 pipeline. No source-level optimization rerun should be introduced in each backend partition.

LLD full-LTO partitions externalize local functions, data and TLS. Restore TU-local binding after native partitions are merged; preserve original bitcode external definitions and merged-native undefineds.
Native undefineds must be collected after the merge, since each individual partition temporarily has undefined references to other partitions promoted locals.
Current ordinary Release compilation is PIC/PIE by default even though the final executable is linked -no-pie. Do not introduce -fno-pie in IR backend commands.
Clang IR backend with matching O3 and target options avoids LLD default per-function/data sections and its mandatory LTO passes.
Compare unsplit optimized IR through the matching Clang backend as the option-parity control; llvm-split -j1 still externalizes by default.
Baked section bounds remain weak undefined after the partial link, and the section retains correct name/type/alignment. Partition padding changes its size.
Codegen and text layout still differ, despite near-identical summed function size. Validate production behavior/performance and keep unsupported configurations on their original path until tested.
